sentences.s: But even as the number of English speakers expands further there are signs that the global predominance of the language may fade within the foreseeable future

components.原文: even as the number of English speakers expands further
components.中文翻译: 尽管讲英语的人数在进一步增加
components.说明: as 引导时间状语从句,even 加让步语气,句首 But 表句间转折。

components.原文: that the global predominance of the language may fade within the foreseeable future
components.中文翻译: 这一语言的全球统治地位在可预见的未来可能会衰落
components.说明: that 引导同位语从句,说明抽象名词 signs 的具体内容,过长可单独译为一句。
介词短语作时间状语,within/in the foreseeable future 为固定搭配。

sentences.zh: 尽管讲英语的人数在进一步增加,但有迹象显示这一语言的全球统治地位在可预见的未来可能会衰落。

sentences.s: His analysis should therefore end any self-contentedness among those who may believe that the global position of English is so stable that the young generations of the United Kingdom do not need additional language capabilities

trunk.主干翻译: 因此,他的分析会终结任何自我满足心态。

components.说明: 介词短语作 self-contentedness 的后置定语,those 指代人。

components.原文: who may believe that the global position of English is so stable that the young generations of the United Kingdom do not need additional language capabilities
components.中文翻译: 这些人或许认为英语的全球地位十分稳固,从而英国的年轻人无需额外的语言能力
components.说明: who 引导定语从句修饰 those,翻译时在此拆开另起一句。

components.原文: that the global position of English is so stable that the young generations of the United Kingdom do not need additional language capabilities
components.中文翻译: 英语的全球地位十分稳固,以至于英国的年轻一代无需额外的语言能力
components.说明: that 引导 believe 的宾语从句,内含 so...that 结构。

components.原文: that the young generations of the United Kingdom do not need additional language capabilities
components.中文翻译: 从而英国的年轻一代无需额外的语言能力
components.说明: so...that 结构中 that 引导结果状语从句,呼应 so。

sentences.zh: 因此,他的分析会让一些人再也无法自满,这些人或许认为英语的全球地位十分稳固,从而英国的年轻人无需额外的语言能力。

sentences.s: many countries are introducing English into the primary-school curriculum but British schoolchildren and students do not appear to be gaining greater encouragement to achieve fluency in other languages

trunk.主干翻译: 许多国家都在把英语纳入小学课程。

components.原文: but British schoolchildren and students do not appear to be gaining greater encouragement to achieve fluency in other languages
components.中文翻译: 但英国的大、中、小学生却似乎没有得到更多的鼓励去熟练掌握其他语言
components.说明: but 连接的并列分句,与前句形成对比。
introduce...into... 固定结构,介词短语作状语,意为把……引入。

components.原文: to achieve fluency in other languages
components.说明: 不定式作 encouragement 的后置定语(非目的状语),可活译为动词短语。

sentences.zh: 许多国家都在把英语纳入小学课程,但英国的大、中、小学生却似乎没有得到更多的鼓励去熟练掌握其他语言。

sentences.s: The changes identified by David Graddol all present clear and major challenges to the UK's providers of English language teaching to people of other countries and to broader education business sectors.

trunk.主干翻译: 这些变化都带来了明显而重大的挑战。

components.成分类型: 非谓语作定语(过去分词)
components.中文翻译: 大卫·格拉多尔所指出的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作 The changes 的后置定语。

components.原文: to the UK's providers of English language teaching to people of other countries
components.中文翻译: 给向其他国家的人提供英语教学的英国机构
components.说明: 介词短语指出 challenges 的对象,说明挑战针对谁。
介词短语作 teaching 的定语,说明教学对象。

components.原文: and to broader education business sectors
components.中文翻译: 以及更广泛的教育产业部门
components.说明: and 连接的并列介词短语,与前一 to 短语并列,共同作 challenges 的对象。

sentences.zh: 大卫·格拉多尔所指出的这些变化,都对向其他国家的人提供英语教学的英国机构以及更广泛的教育产业部门,带来了明显而重大的挑战。

sentences.s: It gives a basis to all organisations which seek to promote the learning and use of English, a basis for planning to meet the possibilities of what could be a very different operating environment

components.原文: to all organisations which seek to promote the learning and use of English
components.中文翻译: 给所有致力于推广英语学习和使用的机构
components.说明: 介词短语作 basis 的后置定语,内嵌 which 定语从句。

components.原文: which seek to promote the learning and use of English
components.中文翻译: 致力于推广英语学习和使用的
components.说明: which 引导定语从句修饰 organisations。

components.原文: a basis for planning to meet the possibilities of what could be a very different operating environment
components.中文翻译: 一个用来筹划应对可能大不相同的运营环境的依据
components.说明: 名词短语作前一 a basis 的同位语,对其加以补充说明。

components.成分类型: 名词性从句(介词宾语从句)
components.原文: what could be a very different operating environment
components.中文翻译: 可能会大不相同的运营环境
components.说明: what 引导名词性从句作介词 of 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 它给所有致力于推广英语学习和使用的机构提供了一个依据,一个用来筹划应对可能会大不相同的运营环境的依据。
